calculation_policy.historical_usage: Range charts apply the recorded price gauge at each evaluation step. Instant panels apply the price gauge at their evaluation time. Results are estimates, not invoices.
calculation_policy.context_tier: standard_short_context is used only when official pricing has separate short- and long-context rates and telemetry cannot distinguish them.
calculation_policy.unknown_effective_dates: null means the official source did not state when the verified rate became effective.
calculation_policy.reasoning_tokens: xAI publishes no separate reasoning rate and grok_code output usage already includes reasoning tokens, so gross output is priced at the output rate.
